page.overview:
Who is Audrii I?

Emperor Audrii I, also known simply as Audrii Corrino, was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 603–669 AG), the first to rule after the First Protectorate (561–603).

Audrii I was a son of Emperor Shaddam I (r. 482–548, 549–553) and brother of Emperor Ezhar I Palaigodes (r. 553–556). In 556, Ezhar's regent Kalus I al-Qair took power over the Imperium as Protector, beginning the First Protectorate. The Protectorate continued under Kalus's relative Harmon II al-Qair, Iason Atreides was instrumental in resolving the differences between the different branches of House Corrino. In 603, Iason persuaded Harmon to step down as Protector in favor of Audrii I's accession as emperor, ending the Protectorate.

For Iason's efforts, Audrii gave him his daughter Salusa's hand in marriage, and in 635 named him Count Aramanli. Iason used his unprecedented influence over the Imperium to reform the imperial government. The Imperial House's power was further counterbalanced with that of the Landsraad, which for the first time was allowed to begin to have regularly scheduled meetings with CHOAM and the Spacing Guild (previously only dealt with through the emperor). The emperor was also made responsible for his actions to the Imperial Family, itself controlled and balanced by the Imperial Household and Imperial Cousines, further diluting imperial power.

Audrii restored the titles of Count Abulurd III Harkonnen, who had been stripped of them by Harmon for refusing to support the Protector's imperial aspirations. The Harkonnens were however demoted again when Abulurd's son, Iosif Harkonnen, was discovered in bed with Audrii's son.
